ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) background with approximately 35% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized to distal regions and linear scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patch at the distal tip of the left lobe; high-density mottled white/gray region across the outer third of the right lobe; dark pigmentation dominates the mid-section and area surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; vertex is visible but depth measurement is partially obscured by water turbulence and spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, moderate-amplitude serrations along the trailing edges; left lobe exhibits a prominent, sharp posterior-lateral tip; right lobe shows more frequent, smaller serrations towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges sweeping to tapered, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and sub-circular high-contrast white clusters distributed within the mottled regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle scar footprints.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of overlapping, multi-directional, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the central and distal portions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense distribution of inter-species rake marks and circular parasitic/epibiotic scars; distinct sharp morphology of the left lobe tip.
